prompt: Leave the voicemail Dad leaves after hearing about your promotion. He is very proud. He will not say that.
response:
[voicemail beep]

"Hey kiddo, it's me. 

So... I heard about the promotion. 

Your mother called. Said you knocked it out of the park. 

Look, I know we don't... I don't do the big speeches. But you should know I wasn't surprised. Not even a little. You've always been like that. Quiet about it, then you just go do the damn thing better than everybody else.

Anyway. 

I'm real proud of you. 

...There. I said it. Don't make it weird.

Call your mother back when you get a chance. She's been pacing around the kitchen like a damn wind-up toy.

Alright. Talk soon."

[click]
